statePlan.fact: TWDB adopted the 2027 State Water Plan Phase I on July 23, 2026. The proposed Phase II amendment comment period closed September 25, 2026 and adoption was tentatively scheduled for December 2026.

drought.fact: U.S. Drought Monitor data available through Drought.gov were valid September 22, 2026 at build time; drought status is a dated weekly snapshot.

bead.fact: Texas BDO reports its BEAD Final Proposal approved December 4, 2025, selecting 22 applicants to serve over 240,000 broadband-serviceable locations and over 2,700 community anchor institutions, with $1.2B federal grant awards and $177M state match; BDO expected projects to begin construction as soon as summer 2026.

mapping.fact: Texas BDO states its public map is useful for coverage and grant planning, while more granular BSL data are available through the FCC National Broadband Map; the BEAD award map is intended to be updated for deployment progress.

trystero.notes: Default Nostr strategy; alternate MQTT, BitTorrent and IPFS packages use one API. makeAction supports message and request/response patterns. Room password strengthens SDP encryption during discovery. TURN can be configured for networks that cannot establish direct WebRTC.

webllm.notes: Browser-local inference using WebGPU with dedicated Web Worker support and model caching.
